summary: The cumulative change outside artifacts/ is a single-line fix in web/doom-boot.js. It sets ArrowUp from 0xaf to 0xad (KEY_UPARROW), so ArrowUp and ArrowDown no longer both map to KEY_DOWNARROW. It matches third_party/doomgeneric/doomkeys.h. The diff touches no third_party, assets, loop or tests files, adds no new exports, and adds no network dependency. I ran no build or tests myself; the controller's final gate already passed.
